subject: why not both...
author: drunknnumpty
body:
personally i am not one for forums.. mostly due to the in fighting and flaming (noob to forums so have no clue).. and i do like the blogging ability on this site.. i would rather have the ability to post my thoughts and comments in one long thread rather than the shorter off the cuff comments in the forum..

as zom said there are lots of forums out there in the wonderful world wide web for pretty much any subject you care to talk about.. but there are not many dedicated burnout sites that allow the blogging function.. we are all here for the same reason and thats the passion for burnout... anyway to get information and hear what other burners are thinking is good to me.. this way rather than having to trawl through a forum and try and follow the multitude of conversation at least you can jump straight to a blog topic and read what your looking for.. and typically people only make comments when they have something relevant to say rather than saying something just because they can..

live and let live.. have forums, blogs.. maybe Xan should even set up a personal wiki for this site.. and just get the burnout message going.. keep racing, raging, crashing and killing your friends...

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...

subject: Boots Forum Request
author: ZombieTron
body: Hi Bootleg, Welcome to BurnoutAholics! We decided not to have a forum and to go with a blog/comment format as there are other Burnout forums available on the other Burnout fansites and we wanted to do something a little different. We also wanted to try to prevent the flame wars and petty bickering which forums seem to attract. However, we are a user driven site so I have put up a poll asking our users opinions on the matter. :-)
